title: WABOT-1 — 1973 Waseda Completion Milestone
summary: Waseda University records that Professor Ichiro Kato's team completed WABOT-1 in 1973. University histories describe the humanoid robot as capable of bipedal walking and simple conversation; later Waseda material also describes object grasping and simple Japanese communication.
significance: A directly institution-documented 1973 completion milestone in Japan's humanoid-robotics history. LINEAiGE records the supported completion year and demonstrated capabilities without converting retrospective priority language into an independent universal 'first-ever' claim.

verification.note: Multiple first-party Waseda University histories independently identify 1973 as the year WABOT-1 was completed or developed and describe its bipedal and conversational capabilities. This candidate preserves year-level precision only. It does not assert an exact completion date, universal priority, system-birth date, causal influence, ancestry, or relationship edge.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Waseda University directly documents WABOT-1's 1973 completion/development milestone and capabilities across multiple institutional histories. The event can be retained as a year-level completion record without relying on stronger retrospective priority claims.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Before canonical admission, locate and assess contemporaneous 1970s WABOT-1 technical publications or archival documentation, distinguish project start from component-development and completion milestones, and evaluate any priority claim separately from the completion record.
